frozen_gates: Disjoint 5,000/5,000 seeds and recorded prewarmed observable features; >=500 test and train samples in every train-defined quintile; >=100 rescue events in each split; held-out weighted mean absolute calibration error <=0.05; held-out Brier score lower than a train-prevalence constant. limits: Synthetic fixed SNR -8.5 dB pre-fading noise only; online q_use timing and confidence-aware admission, multi-SNR/TDL/DU transfer, and GPU joint-policy gain are not established.
